oneLine: Kian-M Export files DRHP with SEBI for an upcoming IPO.

sources.title: Upcoming IPO: Kian-M Export files DRHP with SEBI to raise funds via IPO; key things to know

synopsis: Textile manufacturer and exporter Kian-M Export Ltd has filed its Draft Red Herring Prospectus with the Securities and Exchange Board of India to raise funds through an Initial Public Offering. The proposed public offering comprises a fresh issue of up to ₹ 500 crore and an Offer for Sale of up to 15 lakh shares by existing shareholders. The company intends to use proceeds from the fresh issue for working capital requirements, acquiring a 35.29% stake in Ultra Denim Ltd, funding machinery and equipment purchases, capital expenditure investments in its material subsidiary Usha Cotton Ltd, and general corporate purposes. Mirae Asset Capital Markets is the book running lead manager for the IPO, and MUFG Intime India is the registrar. The shares are proposed to be listed on the National Stock Exchange of India and the BSE.
